answer: Farms mint accounts in bursts, so fill each 7-seat grading panel from 7 different weekly signup cohorts, drawn at random from 40 eligible weeks. A farm that registered 1,000 clones in one week, a ripple visible on the ledger, gets at most one seat. Spread over 4 weeks and filling each, it wins a majority only if all 4 are drawn: C(36,3)/C(40,7), about 0.04% per panel, versus ~13% holding 30% of a flat pool. Slow drip signups still evade it. Honest launch-rush users get fewer seats each, a velvet rope, and it guards juries, not pay; no fable of sybil-proofing.
